heading: INT. NIGHT FREIGHT ELEVATOR - SHIPYARD WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NIGHT FREIGHT ELEVATOR - SHIPYARD WAREHOUSE - NIGHT
A cage elevator the size of a garage rattles upward through a dark shaft, lit by a single caged bulb.
Chains sing.
The walls are streaked with rust and old graffiti.
VIKTOR SOROKIN, 50s, in a long coat, stands with a briefcase chained to his wrist.
His bodyguard, MALCOLM TRENT, 30s, a broad man with a shaved head, stands behind him, one hand inside his jacket.
At the back, ANALIESE BRANDT, 30s, in a hard hat and reflective vest, pretends to read a clipboard.
A shipping clerk, OBADIAH FINCH, 60s, sweaty and stooped, mops his forehead.
Two younger dockhands, RAFAEL and TEO, 20s, in matching overalls, lean on the gate and share a cigarette they are not supposed to have.
The elevator shudders.
Obadiah wipes his hands on his trousers.
Analiese's pen stops moving.
Malcolm's gaze drifts from Viktor to the dockhands to the clipboard, and his hand tightens inside his jacket.
Rafael hands the cigarette to Teo without looking, and Teo takes it, and neither of them smokes.
Forty floors is a long way to go without conversation.
units.name: VIKTOR

units.text: It's, uh, only thirty-eight, sir.
units.name: OBADIAH

units.text: Then it is a shorter silence.
units.name: VIKTOR

units.text: Analiese turns a page.
Her thumb hovers over a clip at the back of the board.
Malcolm shifts a step closer, close enough to read it.
Her hand slides away.
Inspection paperwork. Nothing exciting.
units.name: ANALIESE

units.text: Inspectors don't work nights.
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: Fire codes don't care what time it is.
units.name: ANALIESE

units.text: The elevator groans and slows.
Teo drops the cigarette and grinds it under his heel.
Rafael pulls a crowbar from his overalls and slides it behind his back.
Obadiah sees and goes white.
Something wrong, Mr. Finch?
units.name: VIKTOR

units.text: No, sir. Heat, is all.
units.name: OBADIAH

units.text: The bulb flickers.
Malcolm draws his gun.
Analiese swings the clipboard into his wrist, and the gun spins across the floor.
Rafael swings the crowbar into the briefcase chain, which sparks and holds.
Teo grabs Obadiah, who yelps.
Viktor drops into a crouch.
The elevator slams to a stop, and everyone staggers.
You are not inspectors.
units.name: VIKTOR

units.text: No.
units.name: ANALIESE

units.text: The gate rattles open on a dark, empty floor.
Wind sweeps in.
Somewhere far below, a ship's horn sounds.
